subsection: H. Directors and Officers Liability (D&O) Insurance
text: [Raychem Corp. v. Federal Ins. Co. (ND CA 1994) 853 F.Supp. 1170, 1180 (applying Calif. law); Safeway Stores, Inc. v. National Union Fire Ins. Co. of Pittsburgh, Penn. (9th Cir. 1995) 64 F3d 1282, 1287 (applying Calif. law)] (1) [3:706] Compare—no allocation for respondeat superior liability: The insurer is not entitled to an allocation of settlement and defense costs where the insured corporation is sued solely on the basis of vicarious liability for wrongful acts by its officers/directors. Assuming coverage, the corporation is entitled to full reimbursement of all settlement costs where its liability is purely derivative. [Nordstrom, Inc. v. Chubb & Son, Inc. (9th Cir. 1995) 54 F3d 1424, 1432 (applying Wash. law); Safeway Stores, Inc. v. National Union Fire Ins. Co. of Pittsburgh, Penn., supra, 64 F3d at 1287] b. [3:707] Joinder of claims against noninsured parties: Allocation may also be required where claims against insured 5 officers and directors are joined with claims against other (noninsured) agents and employees of the corporation.
